remnantminimaps.settings.title: Remnants Minimap
remnantminimaps.settings.hint: Left click or the right arrow steps forward, right click or the left arrow steps back. Changes apply immediately.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_enabled.d: Show the minimap on the HUD. The toggle key hides it for the current session only.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_shape.des: A round map in a gilded ring, or a square framed chart.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_anchor.de: Screen corner the minimap sits in. At the top right it moves down to make room for status effects.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_size.desc: Diameter of the minimap in GUI pixels.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_zoom.desc: How much land the minimap shows. Also changed with the zoom keys.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_rotate.de: Turn the map so that where you face is always up. Off keeps north up.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_opacity.d: Fade the minimap so the world shows through.
remnantminimaps.option.icon_scale.desc: Size of markers, the player arrow and radar icons.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_margin.de: Gap between the minimap and the edge of the screen.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_cardinals: Show N, E, S and W around the rim.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_coordinat: Show your block position under the minimap.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_time.desc: Show the part of the day under the minimap.
remnantminimaps.option.minimap_biome.des: Show the name of the biome you are standing in.
remnantminimaps.option.markers_minimap.d: Draw markers on the minimap. Individual markers can still opt out.
remnantminimaps.option.markers_edge.desc: Keep graces, beacons, bloodstains and pillar markers on the rim of the minimap when they are out of view.
remnantminimaps.option.world_beams.desc: Raise golden pillars of light above beacons, graces and bloodstains in the world.
remnantminimaps.option.world_labels.desc: Show the name and distance next to each pillar of light.
remnantminimaps.option.beam_distance.des: Pillars further away than this are not drawn. Distant pillars are pulled to the horizon so they stay visible.
remnantminimaps.option.death_markers.des: Mark the place where you died.
remnantminimaps.option.death_limit.desc: How many bloodstains to keep before the oldest fades away.
remnantminimaps.option.bed_marker.desc: Mark the last bed you slept in.
remnantminimaps.option.radar_players.des: Show nearby players on the maps.
remnantminimaps.option.radar_hostiles.de: Show nearby hostile mobs on the minimap.
remnantminimaps.option.radar_passives.de: Show nearby animals and other passive mobs on the minimap.
remnantminimaps.option.map_labels.desc: Write marker names on the world map when zoomed in.
remnantminimaps.option.map_clouds.desc: Swirling clouds in the corners of the world map.
remnantminimaps.option.map_hints.desc: Show the controls along the bottom of the world map. Press H on the map to toggle.
remnantminimaps.option.map_compass.desc: Show the compass rose in the corner of the world map.
remnantminimaps.option.map_dial.desc: Show the day-cycle dial on the world map.
remnantminimaps.option.map_grid.desc: Draw faint lines along region borders on the world map.
remnantminimaps.option.pixelated.desc: Keep individual blocks sharp when zoomed in closely. Off blends them smoothly.
remnantminimaps.option.palette.desc: Parchment gives the muted, hand-drawn look. Classic keeps Minecraft's own map colors.
remnantminimaps.option.contours.desc: Ink lines that follow the height of the land.
Height between contour lines. Every fourth line is drawn darker.
remnantminimaps.option.hillshade.desc: Strength of the light and shadow that give hills their shape.
remnantminimaps.option.water_engraving.d: Fine wave lines across deeper water.
remnantminimaps.option.paper_grain.desc: Subtle fibers and stains, as if drawn on old paper.
remnantminimaps.option.ink_outlines.desc: Outline coasts, buildings and roads in ink.
remnantminimaps.option.scan_budget.desc: Time per tick spent reading terrain. Higher fills the map faster, lower is lighter on slow machines.
remnantminimaps.option.max_regions.desc: How many 256x256 regions stay loaded. Each takes about 0.8 MB.
